_source: Client-supplied slides, sent by Maddie 2026-09-02. Wording is taken from those slides. Nothing here is inferred.
_open_questions: Limited lifetime warranty: the slide says MANUFACTURER'S, covering factory defects. Does Love Is Blinds' own workmanship/installation sit under the 4-year service guarantee instead?
GuaranTEN: is the free replacement one per ten on a single order, or cumulative across everything a customer ever buys? Any time limit?
4-Year Service: runs from install date? Labour only, or parts too? Does it cover motors?
Apples-to-apples price match: what proof is needed, and does it apply to online-only retailers or local competitors only?
Transferable warranty: does the new homeowner have to register or notify anyone?

guarantees.name: Limited Lifetime Warranty
guarantees.text: Your window treatments come with a manufacturer's limited lifetime warranty. Any factory defects found in your treatments are covered for life.

guarantees.name: Apples-to-Apples Price Match
guarantees.text: We stand behind our pricing. If you find the same treatment specified the same way for less, we match it, so you can buy without second-guessing the number.

guarantees.name: The GuaranTEN
guarantees.text: For every ten window treatments you buy, we replace one free. Break it, stop liking it, get tired of it: we replace it, no questions asked.

guarantees.name: Here-4-You Service Guarantee
guarantees.short: Four years of service at no cost
guarantees.text: We offer a four-year service guarantee. If anything goes wrong with your blinds, shades or shutters, we come out and service them at no cost.

guarantees.name: Transferable Warranty
guarantees.text: Whether this is your forever home or not, the warranty transfers when you sell, so the cover stays with the windows rather than expiring with the move.
